description:
What an approved plan changed.

The result reports what happened, never what was intended. A plan that
was refused or only partly applied is reported as such.

approval_id.description: Approval the apply was made with.

created.description: Node ids that exist after the apply.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the canonical plan that was applied.

undo_committed.description: Whether the plugin committed the plan as one undo step.

version_saved.description: Version id, when a version checkpoint was written.

warnings.description: Non fatal caveats of the apply.

title: WriteResult
